data.title: Evil Huntar AR Game Concept Testing
data.surveyname: Evil Huntar AR Game Concept Testing
data.about: This is a Concept Testing, Usage & Attitude Study for Evil Huntar, an AR game concept similar to Pokémon Go. The study aims to gather critical insights to inform game design, development, and marketing strategies.
data.info: Suitable for businesses looking to understand market viability, player preferences, safety considerations, and branding feedback related to AR gaming.

data.title: Women's Decision-Making in Indian Families
data.about: This is a Social Impact & Behavioral Study that focuses on understanding the societal roles and behavioral patterns of women in family decision-making, providing actionable insights for empowerment initiatives.
data.info: Suitable for quantifying the current state of women's decision-making power within families and understanding the direct impact of financial independence on women's influence.

data.title: The Side Hustle Motivations & Landscape
data.about: This is a Usage & Attitude Study that deeply explores the behaviors, preferences, and motivations of individuals engaged in side hustles, providing a comprehensive understanding of this market segment.
data.info: Suitable for businesses looking to understand how to effectively engage with individuals pursuing side hustles, whether for talent acquisition, partnership opportunities, or market entry.

data.title: AI Parshurama Teaser: Audience Perception
data.about: This is a Concept Test & Perception Study that evaluates audience reactions to AI-generated videos, and measures various facets of perception, from emotional impact to acceptance, providing actionable insights for creative and strategic development.
data.info: Suitable for businesses looking to optimize the creative direction for future AI-generated projects, and refining branding and content themes

data.title: A Study of Dhurandhar
data.about: A Sentiment & Perception Study that employs quantitative and qualitative methods to accurately measure and understand the true national sentiment towards the film "Dhurandhar" in order to inform future content strategies, public relations, and audience engagement approaches for similar narratives.
data.info: Suitable for businesses looking to optimize the creative direction for future AI-generated projects, and refining branding and content themes

data.title: Indian Snacking Behaviour - Diary Study
data.about:
This research is triggered by the need to capture authentic, real-time consumer behavior in the snacking category.

		Traditional recall-based surveys often suffer from memory bias; by requiring an immediate photo upload, we fill the knowledge gap between what consumers say they eat and what they actually consume. This study is critical for identifying current visual trends and flavor preferences in the fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) space.
data.info: Suitable for businesses looking to optimize the creative direction for future AI-generated projects, and refining branding and content themes

data.title: Tiger (or) Zandu - A Study on Pain Balms
data.about: This research is critical to fill knowledge gaps regarding consumer affinity towards traditional pain balms like Zandu Balm and Tiger Balm, their perceived differences from Western alternatives, and their market growth potential (especially among Gen Z)
data.info: It also offers nuanced perceptions regarding safety, ingredient understanding, addiction, and potential overuse as a 'cure-all'.

data.title: Holiday Gifting - Urban Indian Trends
data.about: This research is critical now to provide a comprehensive view of gifting behaviours across major festive seasons (Diwali, Christmas, New Years, Holi), distinguishing between traditional and non-traditional gifts, and analyzing the underlying motivations and spending patterns. It aims to fill a knowledge gap regarding the 'why' behind gifting trends, market size, and emerging consumer desires, thereby informing strategic product development and marketing initiatives.
data.info: Understand the evolving landscape of holiday gifting in urban India to capitalize on market opportunities and address changing consumer preferences.

data.title: Digital Subscriptions - The Indian Edition
data.about: This research is triggered by the need to map the shift from free app usage to paid ecosystem loyalty. By quantifying app density and subscription counts, we aim to identify the saturation point of digital services and the primary drivers of daily active usage in the Indian market.
data.info: In an increasingly mobile-first economy, understanding the 'digital real estate' a user occupies is critical for competitive positioning.

retail.title: The Indian Beauty Landscape: Decoded
retail.surveyname: Evil Huntar AR Game Concept Testing
retail.about: The Indian beauty market is experiencing a digital revolution, driven by socially-conscious, digitally-native consumers who are reshaping the rules of engagement. This comprehensive study of 719 female beauty consumers across India reveals a market in transformation: sponsored content builds trust, 70% feel social media pressure yet remain discriminating purchasers, and Gen Z's spending power drives premiumization despite price consciousness.
retail.info: Suitable for businesses looking to understand market viability, player preferences, safety considerations, and branding feedback related to AR gaming.
